items.title: Kalshi becomes first CFTC-regulated exchange to launch single-stock perpetual futures, Motley Fool reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi becomes first CFTC-regulated exchange to launch single-stock perpetual futures, Motley Fool reports** — The CFTC greenlit equity perpetual futures for US trading in early November, and Kalshi became the first CFTC-regulated exchange to launch single-stock perps, offering long or short positions on more than 50 individual stocks including Meta, Palantir and McDonald's, as well as indexes. Wall Street trade groups including the Capital Markets Alliance Association have filed lawsuits to block equity perps. (Motley Fool)
